title: AI越强漏洞越多：Zscaler需求暴涨，CEO点破真正原因？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Start off first with this idea here of Zero Trust, the Signature Cloud Security platform.
segments.zh: 首先从零信任这个标志性云安全平台说起。

segments.en: And some sense here, Jay, can you share with us what demand is looking like and whether that demand has actually increased materially this year,
segments.zh: Jay，能否分享一下当前需求情况，以及今年需求是否显著增长，

segments.en: given all of the incidents and focus on cybersecurity?
segments.zh: 考虑到所有事件和对网络安全的关注？

segments.en: In short, the demand is growing very rapidly.
segments.zh: 简而言之，需求正在快速增长。

segments.en: Let me explain why. Every CEO and every board believes that AI must be adopted because it can increase your top line
segments.zh: 让我解释原因。每位CEO和董事会都认为必须采用AI，因为它能提升营收

segments.en: and it can improve your bottom line as well. But the biggest concern CIOs and CISOs have is cyber security.
segments.zh: 也能改善利润。但CIO和CISO最担心的是网络安全。

segments.en: Can these agents go rogue and the like? That is why it's creating a big demand for cyber security and especially for Zero Trust Security.
segments.zh: 这些代理会失控吗？因此对网络安全，尤其是零信任安全的需求大增。

segments.en: Because you don't want AI agents to be running on your corporate network and Z-scaler fixes that.
segments.zh: 因为你不希望AI代理在企业网络上运行，Zscaler解决了这个问题。

segments.en: Well, give me a sense here, though. I remember on your last conference call, you talked about this idea of a lot of the frontier models were sort of multiplying at sort of this exponential level
segments.zh: 不过，请谈谈。我记得上次电话会议，你提到许多前沿模型正以指数级速度增长

segments.en: almost. And I do wonder how you keep up as a cybersecurity company when the technology that effectively you're up against has, if not the same power as you,
segments.zh: 几乎如此。作为网络安全公司，当面对的技术力量与你相当甚至更强时，你如何跟上？

segments.en: maybe even more. Well, it is true that frontier models are very powerful.
segments.zh: 甚至更多。前沿模型确实非常强大。

segments.en: These models can find vulnerabilities in almost any software.
segments.zh: 这些模型能发现几乎所有软件中的漏洞。
